claim: In the SNS Publish API throttling table, all other supported Regions have 300 messages per second for standard topics and 3,000 messages per second for FIFO topics; SNS FIFO per-topic limits exceed this default per-account limit when FifoThroughputScope is set to MessageGroup.

qualifiers.scope: per account, per Region (all other supported Regions)
qualifiers.condition: A soft limit increase can be requested through an SNS quota increase request.

evidence.quote: | All other supported Regions | 300 messages per second | 3,000 messages per second |
evidence.table_header: | AWS Regions | Standard topics | FIFO topics\* |

evidence.quote: Amazon SNS FIFO per topic limits exceed the default per account limit when FifoThroughputScope is set to MessageGroup.
